text: In the 1890s Ephraim Winslow [signs on for four weeks as a keeper on a remote New England island|trigger|saying yes to an offer] under the demanding former sailor Thomas Wake, who keeps the lantern room to himself. Winslow scrubs and hauls and dreams of [a mermaid carved in scrimshaw|images|dolls, masks and likenesses], and Wake warns him never to harm the gulls, which hold the souls of dead sailors. When Winslow [beats a one-eyed gull to death|rules|break the rule and pay], the wind turns, the relief boat never comes, and the two men [drink and quarrel through an endless storm|images|weather, sky and darkness].
